errors.core.addressInvalid: Enter the address as host:port, for example 192.168.1.10:2376.
errors.core.ioFailed: A file or system operation failed.
errors.core.remoteSocketNotAbsolute: The remote socket path must be absolute, like /var/run/docker.sock.
errors.core.sshPortInvalid: The SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.core.unreadableData: Homeport received data it couldn't read.
errors.engine.alreadyInState: The container is already in that state.
errors.engine.apiVersionUnreadable: The Docker Engine reported an API version Homeport can't read.
errors.engine.apiVersionUnsupported: This Docker Engine's API version isn't supported.
errors.engine.authRequired: The image doesn't exist, or it's private.
errors.engine.authRequired.hint: Check the image name. If it's private, add a login for its registry in Settings → Registries.
errors.engine.badRequest: The Docker Engine rejected the request as invalid.
errors.engine.commandNotFound: That command doesn't exist in the container.
errors.engine.commandNotFound.hint: Minimal images may have no shell or tools. Try /bin/sh, or another command.
errors.engine.conflict: This clashes with the current state of the Docker Engine.
errors.engine.containerGone.hint: It was probably removed elsewhere. The list refreshes on its own.
errors.engine.containerNameInUse: That container name is already used.
errors.engine.containerNameInUse.hint: Pick another name, or remove or rename the other container first.
errors.engine.containerRunning.hint: Stop it first, or remove it with force.
errors.engine.cpusFewer: This host has fewer CPUs than the limit asks for.
errors.engine.cpusLimited: This host has only {cpus} CPUs to give a container.
errors.engine.cpusLimited.hint: Lower the CPU limit, or leave it empty to use every CPU.
errors.engine.cpusLimited.one: This host has only {cpus} CPU to give a container.
errors.engine.diskFull: The Docker Engine is out of disk space.
errors.engine.diskFull.hint: Remove unused images, containers and volumes (Prune on the Overview page), or free space on the machine it runs on.
errors.engine.failed: The Docker Engine failed to do this.
errors.engine.failed.hint: The Docker Engine's exact answer is in Details.
errors.engine.forbidden: The Docker Engine refused to do this.
errors.engine.forbidden.hint: An authorisation plugin or a rootless Docker Engine may forbid it. The exact answer is in Details.
errors.engine.gone: This no longer exists on the Docker Engine.
errors.engine.gone.hint: It was probably removed elsewhere. The lists refresh on their own.
errors.engine.gpuUnavailable: This host can't give containers a GPU.
errors.engine.gpuUnavailable.hint: Install the GPU vendor's container toolkit on the host (for NVIDIA, the NVIDIA Container Toolkit) and restart the Docker Engine, or run the container without a GPU.
errors.engine.imageGone: This image no longer exists on the Docker Engine.
errors.engine.imageInUse: This image is used by a container.
errors.engine.imageInUse.hint: Remove the containers that use it, or force the removal.
errors.engine.imageOrTagMissing: This image or tag doesn't exist.
errors.engine.imageOrTagMissing.hint: Check the image name and tag on the registry.
errors.engine.imageSeveralTags.hint: Force the removal to delete every tag, or remove the tags one by one.
errors.engine.invalidImageName.hint: Use a name like nginx:1.27 or registry.example.com/team/app:tag, in lower case.
errors.engine.loginFailed: The registry refused the stored user name and password.
errors.engine.loginFailed.hint: Check the login for this registry in Settings → Registries.
errors.engine.networkInUse: This network still has containers attached.
errors.engine.networkInUse.hint: Disconnect or remove its containers first.
errors.engine.pathMissing: That path doesn't exist in the container.
errors.engine.portInUse.hint: Stop the container or program that uses it, or publish this container on another port.
errors.engine.publishedPortInUse: A published port is already in use.
errors.engine.rateLimited: The registry's pull limit was reached.
errors.engine.rateLimited.hint: Docker Hub limits anonymous pulls. Wait for the limit to reset (up to 6 hours), or add a Docker Hub login in Settings → Registries, which raises the limit.
errors.engine.registryUnreachable: The Docker Engine can't reach the image registry.
errors.engine.registryUnreachable.hint: Check the internet access, DNS and proxy settings of the machine it runs on.
errors.engine.stopped.hint: Check that it's still running. Homeport reconnects on its own.
errors.engine.timeout: The Docker Engine didn't answer in time.
errors.engine.timeout.hint: It may be busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.engine.tlsRequired: This Docker Engine only accepts TLS connections.
errors.engine.tlsRequired.hint: Change the connection to TLS on the host page and add the Engine's certificates.
errors.engine.unreadableAnswer: The Docker Engine sent an answer Homeport can't read.
errors.engine.unreadableAnswer.hint: The Engine may be much newer or older than Homeport supports. Updating both usually helps.
errors.engine.volumeInUse: This volume is used by a container.
errors.engine.volumeInUse.hint: Remove the containers that use it first.
errors.file.diskFull: There's no space left to write {path}.
errors.file.diskFull.hint: Free some disk space, or pick another drive.
errors.file.folderNotOpened.hint: Open it in your file manager instead.
errors.file.forbidden.hint: Check the file's permissions, or pick another location.
errors.file.isFolder: {path} is a folder, not a file.
errors.file.tooLarge: {path} is too large to be a key, certificate or compose file.
errors.reach.connectionLost.hint: The machine or the network may have restarted. Homeport keeps retrying.
errors.reach.engineConnectionLost: The connection to the Docker Engine was cut.
errors.secrets.credentialsLost.hint: The key that protects them is gone from the OS keychain. Re-enter the credentials on the host page, or regenerate the key.
errors.secrets.keychainUnavailable: The OS keychain is unavailable, so secrets can't be stored.
Install and unlock a Secret Service keyring, such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then restart Homeport.
Unlock the login keychain in Keychain Access, then restart Homeport.
Make sure Windows Credential Manager is available, then restart Homeport.
errors.storage.dbCorrupt.hint: Quit Homeport, move homeport.db out of its data folder and start again. Hosts and stacks will need to be added again.
errors.storage.dbLocked.hint: Another Homeport may be running. Close it and try again.
errors.storage.diskFull: The disk is full, so Homeport can't save.
errors.storage.diskFull.hint: Free some disk space and try again.
errors.storage.referenceGone: Something this refers to no longer exists.
errors.transport.connect.engineTimeout: The Docker Engine didn't answer in time.
errors.transport.connect.tlsMaterialMiss: Add the CA certificate, client certificate and client key on the host page.
errors.transport.local.notInstalled: The Docker Engine doesn't seem to be installed: nothing exists at {path}.
errors.transport.local.notInstalled.linu: Install Docker Engine (see docs.docker.com/engine/install), for example with Docker's install script, then let your user use it:
errors.transport.local.notInstalled.maco: Install Docker Desktop, OrbStack or Colima. With Homebrew, Colima is:
errors.transport.local.notInstalled.wind: Install Docker Desktop (see docs.docker.com/desktop), then open it:
errors.transport.local.notRunning: No Docker Engine is running at {path}.
errors.transport.local.notRunning.docker: Open Docker Desktop and wait until its Engine is running.
Start the Docker Engine, and have it start with the computer:
Start your rootless Docker Engine, and have it start when you log in:
errors.transport.local.notRunning.orbSta: Open OrbStack, or start it from a terminal:
errors.transport.local.notRunning.ranche: Open Rancher Desktop and wait until its Engine is running.
errors.transport.local.notRunning.unknow: Start the Docker Engine that provides this socket, or check the socket path on the host page.
errors.transport.local.permissionDenied: Homeport isn't allowed to use the Docker Engine at {path}.
Add your user to the docker group, then log out and back in (or restart) so it applies:
Add your user to the docker-users group in an administrator terminal, then sign out and back in:
Check who may use the socket:
errors.transport.local.timeout: The Docker Engine at {path} didn't answer in time.
errors.transport.local.timeout.hint: It may be starting or overloaded. Homeport keeps retrying.
errors.transport.local.unreachable: Homeport can't talk to the Docker Engine at {path}.
errors.transport.local.unreachable.hint: Check that the Docker Engine is running, then reconnect.
errors.transport.network.dnsFailed: The name of {host} can't be found.
errors.transport.network.dnsFailed.hint: Check the address for typos, and that this computer's network and DNS work.
errors.transport.network.failed.hint: Check the address and your network, then reconnect.
errors.transport.network.refused.hint: Check the port, that the service listens on it, and that no firewall blocks it.
errors.transport.network.timeout.hint: Check the address, that the machine is on, and that no firewall drops the connection.
errors.transport.network.unreachable: {host} can't be reached from this network.
errors.transport.network.unreachable.hin: Check your network connection, or connect the VPN it's behind.
errors.transport.ssh.agentFailed: The ssh-agent failed to sign in.
errors.transport.ssh.agentFailed.hint: Check that the agent holds your key with `ssh-add -l`.
errors.transport.ssh.agentUnavailable.un: Start an agent and add your key in the terminal Homeport is launched from, or pick another authentication method:
errors.transport.ssh.agentUnavailable.wi: Start the OpenSSH Authentication Agent service in an administrator PowerShell, then add your key:
errors.transport.ssh.authRefused: The SSH server refused to let {user}@{host} log in.
errors.transport.ssh.authRefused.agent.h: Load a key the SSH server accepts into your ssh-agent, then reconnect.
errors.transport.ssh.authRefused.key.hin: Authorise Homeport's key for {user} by running this on {host}:
errors.transport.ssh.authRefused.publicK: Add this host's public key to authorized_keys on {host}.
errors.transport.ssh.engineNotInstalled: The Docker Engine isn't installed on {host}.
Install it on {host}, for example with Docker's install script, then let {user} use it:
errors.transport.ssh.engineNotRunning: The Docker Engine isn't running on {host}: nothing listens at {path}.
errors.transport.ssh.engineNotRunning.hi: Start it on {host}, and have it start with the machine:
errors.transport.ssh.enginePermissionDen: {user} isn't allowed to use the Docker Engine on {host}.
On {host}, add {user} to the docker group. It applies to new logins, so reconnect afterwards:
errors.transport.ssh.forwardingDisabled: The SSH server on {host} doesn't allow forwarding to the Docker Engine socket.
Allow it in sshd's configuration on {host}, then restart sshd (the service is "sshd" on some systems):
errors.transport.ssh.hostKeyChanged: The SSH server's key changed since it was trusted.
errors.transport.ssh.hostKeyChanged.hint: If the machine was reinstalled, trust the new key on the host page. Otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection.
errors.transport.ssh.hostKeyUntrusted: The SSH server's key isn't trusted yet ({fingerprint}).
errors.transport.ssh.hostKeyUntrusted.hi: Check the fingerprint, then trust the key on the host page.
errors.transport.ssh.keyMissing: The SSH private key is missing.
errors.transport.ssh.keyMissing.hint: Add a private key on the host page, or generate one.
errors.transport.ssh.keyUnreadable: The SSH private key can't be read.
errors.transport.ssh.keyUnreadable.hint: Check that it's an OpenSSH or PEM private key and that the passphrase is right.
errors.transport.ssh.noCommonAlgorithm: Homeport and the SSH server at {host} share no encryption method.
errors.transport.ssh.noCommonAlgorithm.h: Update OpenSSH on that machine, or allow modern algorithms such as ed25519 and curve25519 in its sshd_config.
errors.transport.ssh.publicKeyUnencodabl: The private key's public half can't be encoded.
errors.transport.ssh.socketUnavailable: {user} can't open the Docker Engine socket at {path} on {host}.
errors.transport.ssh.socketUnavailable.h: Check that the Docker Engine runs on {host} and that {user} may use it. On {host}, run:
errors.transport.ssh.stoppedAnswering: The SSH server at {host} stopped answering.
errors.transport.ssh.stoppedAnswering.hi: Check that the machine is on and reachable. Homeport keeps retrying.
errors.transport.tls.caEmpty: The CA certificate contains no certificate.
errors.transport.tls.caUnusable: The CA certificate can't be used.
errors.transport.tls.certExpired.hint: Renew the Docker Engine's TLS certificate, then reconnect.
errors.transport.tls.certNotYetValid: The certificate of {host} isn't valid yet.
errors.transport.tls.certNotYetValid.hin: Check that this computer's date and time are right.
errors.transport.tls.clientCertEmpty: The client certificate contains no certificate.
errors.transport.tls.clientCertExpired.h: Make a new client certificate signed by the Engine's CA and paste it on the host page.
errors.transport.tls.clientCertUnusable: The client certificate can't be used.
errors.transport.tls.clientKeyUnusable: The client key can't be used.
errors.transport.tls.clientPairUnusable: The client certificate and key can't be used.
errors.transport.tls.clientRejected.hint: Use a client certificate (cert.pem and key.pem) signed by the CA the Engine trusts, its --tlscacert.
errors.transport.tls.configUnusable: The TLS configuration can't be used.
errors.transport.tls.handshakeFailed.hin: Check the certificates on the host page against the ones the Engine uses.
errors.transport.tls.materialInvalid.hin: Paste PEM files (ca.pem, cert.pem, key.pem) made for this Engine on the host page.
errors.transport.tls.nameMismatch: The certificate of {host} isn't made for {name}.
errors.transport.tls.nameMismatch.hint: Connect with a name or IP address listed in the certificate, or reissue it to include this one.
errors.transport.tls.notSupported.hint: Use a TCP connection for this address, or the Engine's TLS port (usually 2376).
errors.transport.tls.unknownCa: The certificate of {host} isn't signed by the CA certificate on the host page.
errors.transport.tls.unknownCa.hint: Paste the ca.pem that signed the Engine's certificate.
errors.updates.adminRefused: Installing the update needs an administrator's approval, which was refused or cancelled.
errors.updates.adminRefused.hint: Try again and enter an administrator password when asked.
errors.updates.byPackageManager: This copy of Homeport is updated by your package manager.
errors.updates.download.hint: Check your internet connection, then try again.
errors.updates.nonePublished: No update is published for this system yet.
errors.updates.nonePublished.hint: Try again later, or download Homeport from its website.
errors.updates.notAllowed: Homeport isn't allowed to replace its own files.
errors.updates.notAllowed.hint: Move the AppImage to a folder you own, or install Homeport from its package repository.
errors.updates.nothingWaiting: No update is waiting to be installed.
errors.updates.signature: The update's signature doesn't match, so it wasn't installed.
errors.updates.signature.hint: Download the new version from Homeport's website instead.
errors.updates.wrongDisk: Homeport can't replace itself where it's installed.
errors.updates.wrongDisk.hint: Move Homeport to a folder on your main disk, or install it from its package repository.
